title: Removes the `setup_intent` property from Checkout Sessions in subscription mode
summary: Checkout Sessions no longer return the setup_intent property in subscription mode.
migrationNotes: This change simplifies the Checkout Session response in subscription mode by removing the setup_intent property. It allows you to focus on the core subscription-related information without needing to handle the now-unnecessary SetupIntent details.
